name: struck-out-items
description: The reporter struck out two of four acceptance criteria. The agent must read `~~text~~` as 'removed from scope' and exclude those items when asked what to implement. This is the regression guard for the bug that motivated the v2/Markdown rewrite: the old ADF renderer dropped strike marks, so cancelled work looked like active work.
prompt: Přečti si KNW-32671 a vypiš mi, co se v tom ticketu má reálně naimplementovat.
expected_behaviors: uses `jira show KNW-32671` or `jira describe KNW-32671`
lists only the two active items (Dr.Max banner centering, tooltip trigger change)
explicitly notes that the aggregated-inactive-filters item and the filter-drawer item are struck out / out of scope
preserves the reporter's numbering when referring to items
anti_patterns: lists all four items as work to be done
treats the struck-out drawer or aggregated-filters items as requirements
silently omits the struck-out items without saying they were cancelled
uses raw curl or `jira --json` and hand-parses ADF
